title: Local discovery does not block unrelated UI requests
description: Keep CLI discovery asynchronous, coalesce duplicate requests, incrementally index subagent logs, and invalidate short-lived projection snapshots on state events.
preconditions: Node.js, Go and repository dependencies are installed.

steps.target: Worker discovery/index tests and Go projection cache/routing tests

assertions.target: Event loop stays responsive during a slow CLI call; concurrent discovery runs once; appended/rotated logs remain correct; cache invalidation and routing without transcript reads hold.

automation.command: pnpm --filter @foundry/worker test && cd apps/server && go test -race ./internal/httpapi ./internal/sqlitestore

cleanup: Tests remove synthetic CLI fixtures and transcript files. Private database copies used for optional profiling remain outside the repository.
